title: A/R Detail: Totals follow the customer, Past due and Location filters
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • {Customer-A} has an invoice of $1,000.00 at {Location-A} 15 days past due, an invoice of $400.00 at {Location-B} 45 days past due and an unused credit memo of $150.00 at {Location-A}; {Customer-B} has an invoice of $700.00 at {Location-A} 45 days past due and an invoice of $250.00 at {Location-B} 100 days past due; {Customer-C} has an invoice of $900.00 at {Location-A} 5 days past due. Nothing else is open for the three on today's date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-09 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-09 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-09 Charlie.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Customer filter, tick {Customer-A} and {Customer-B}.
  2. Read the Totals row's Open balance.
  3. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days".
  4. Expand every group and read the rows and the Totals row.
  5. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  6. Expand every group and read the rows and the Totals row.
  7. Download the PDF and the CSV from the ⋯ menu and read their Totals rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: only the two customers' documents remain; {Customer-C}'s $900.00 is gone.
  • Step 2: $2,200.00 (1,000.00 + 400.00 − 150.00 + 700.00 + 250.00): the Totals row follows the customer filter.
  • Step 3: the chip reads "Past due: 31-60 days".
  • Step 4: the rows are the $400.00 and $700.00 documents (45 days past due) and the $150.00 credit memo, which is always kept; the Totals row reads $950.00 (400.00 + 700.00 − 150.00).
  • Step 5: the report narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 6: the rows are the $700.00 document and the $150.00 credit memo; the Totals row reads $550.00 (700.00 − 150.00).
  • Step 7: both Totals rows read $550.00, the same as the screen.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
  • S5-R16: “With ranges ticked, A/R Detail, A/R Collection, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices keep only the invoices and bills whose days past due on the as-of date fall in a ticked range, and always keep credit memos, deposits and vendor credits.”
  • S5-R7: “which location an A/P row belongs to, stated per document (bill: its delivery; vendor credit from a return: the return; other vendor credits: the vendor).”
